content.text:
Image 1: Five-panel storyboard reference, used for the overall shot structure, shot sizes, and camera-movement rhythm. Read it from left to right and from top to bottom; panel N is Shot N. It is a line-art sketch: do not adopt its sketch style, black outlines, white background, panel borders or drawn faces.
Image 2: Reference of INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, a rendered set, not live action. Use it only for the room's layout, the furniture's positions and the light's direction; do not reference its visual content. It contains no people.
Image 3: Reference of INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 4: Reference of INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 5: Reference of INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 6: Reference of INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 7: Blocking reference of the segment's start: the same place with these people in their places, used only for where each person is and which way they face; take faces and outfits from each subject's own image. It is a line-art diagram: do not adopt its outlines or white background.
Image 8: Subject 1 (Ji Ran, look S0) character appearance reference.
Image 9: Prop 1 (pour-over coffee equipment) maps to this image; copy its writing and badges exactly from Image 9.
From each prop's image, use only structure, material, and color.
[Subject settings]
Subject 1 (Ji Ran): Refer to Image 8. 27, heroine; owner of Jiejian Company, an architecture and interior design firm; daughter of Ji Hongyuan. Outfit: look S0: Office, day one: a fitted dove-grey silk button-down shirt with long sleeves, tucked in, the top two buttons open. A black high-waisted bodycon pencil skirt to just above the knee, cinched at the waist with a thin black leather belt. Black pointed-toe stiletto pumps. Signature colour: black.
Environment (INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE): Refer to Images 2 to 6. Day, soft daylight through the floor-to-ceiling windows. Daylight from the windows behind the desk, warm ceiling spots and the desk task lamp. Faint city hum through the glass.
Do not swap the characters' appearances, clothing, actions, positions or dialogue.
[Subjects and relationships]
Only one person appears throughout: Ji Ran.
[Blocking]
Refer to Images 2 to 6 for the room and Image 7 for the people's places. Ji Ran stands behind the walnut executive desk in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows, facing the pin-up wall. She wears the dove-grey silk shirt and the black pencil skirt. The white coffee cup, now filled, sits on its saucer at the pour-over station beside the kettle, dripper and server. The plans, wood samples and metal figurine lie across the desktop, and the black leather chair stands behind her. Camera side: in front of the desk, on the pin-up wall side, facing the desk and the windows.
[Overall style]
Photorealistic live-action short drama with cinematic lighting. Each character keeps the face and the outfit with its main colour from their reference image throughout. Use each character sheet only for that character: the face from the close-up on the right, the body and outfit from the turnaround on the left; do not render the sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. This segment has 1 line, in this order: Ji Ran (V.O.). Generate speech only from the lines in {} in the shot list, each spoken exactly once by its speaker; everyone else keeps their mouth naturally closed while listening, and a V.O. speaker keeps their mouth closed or is off screen. Follow the shot list below; do not add cuts or camera moves beyond it. Strictly adhere to the 180-degree rule: within a scene, characters keep their screen sides and the camera stays on one side of the axis. Seamless continuity of action; cut on action. For dialogue prefer static shot-reverse-shot and over-the-shoulder shots, balanced with reaction shots and close-up inserts. Faces stable and clear, with no resemblance to any real actor or actress. Normal human eyes. Natural anatomy. Natural, fluid motion that follows the blocking; characters make subtle, natural movements. Characters, props and environment share one world with matched lighting. Each line ends naturally with breathing room and is never cut off. Authentic performances with micro-expressions. No BGM; generate only dialogue, environmental sounds and action sounds. No subtitles.
[Continuity]
Maintain continuity in the identities, number, appearance, clothing, relative heights, spatial positions, and eyelines of all the characters. The actions in the shot list occur strictly in sequence. Hands are anatomically correct.
[Strictly exclude]
lip movement during the voice-over. subtitles or garbled text. spatial jumps. Dialogue from the wrong character, multiple people speaking at once, repeated or missing lines, lip-sync errors and audio-visual desynchronization. The raw reference images (character sheets, setting plates) appearing as a frame of the video, and starting on a still frame of the setting reference. A fast zoom-in at the start, a fast pull-back at the end, unmotivated whip-pans, tilts, zooms and 360-degree orbits. Axis-crossing, jump cuts, frame skips, flicker and clipping. Face swaps, changes in age or clothing, sudden height shifts, added or missing characters, spatial jumps, and disordered action sequences; props popping in or vanishing, and duplicate characters except mirror reflections. Hand clipping, extra fingers, fused fingers, malformed hands. Subtitles, captions, watermarks and garbled writing; writing and logos other than those on a key prop's reference image, which are copied from it; a phone screen or paper that is not a key prop is shown from the back or out of focus. Black-and-white, monochrome, grayscale, desaturated visuals; hand-drawn, sketch, line art, illustration, comics, animation; storyboard frames, rough sketches, panel borders, gutters and grid layouts.
[Shot list] (5 shots, approximately 14 seconds)
When a previous-shot reference image is given, it is the moment this segment starts from: keep its people's positions, outfits, props and light, and continue from there. Shot 1 keeps its own camera, matching the image's framing only when it frames the same view; do not repeat that frame later.
Shot 1 (0-4s): [Medium close-up, slow push in, eye level, from the front of the desk] Ji Ran lifts the white cup and sips, her eyes distant and her lips on the rim. Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, low and bitter): {五年前，纪宏远逼走路少泽，让我跟陈家联姻。}
Shot 2 (4-6s): [Close-up insert, locked-off camera, high angle, over the pour-over station] Ji Ran's hand sets the cup back down firmly on its saucer. Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, cool): {现在路少泽发达了，} <Porcelain clicks>
Shot 3 (6-9s): [Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the pin-up wall facing the desk and the windows] Ji Ran turns from the desk toward the floor-to-ceiling windows and the city skyline, her mouth closed. Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, scornful): {又迫不及待悔婚，把我塞给路少泽。}
Shot 4 (9-11s): [Medium shot, locked-off camera, low angle, from the front of the desk] Ji Ran turns back toward the pin-up wall and plants both hands on the desk beside the plans. Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, hard): {在他眼里，我永远都只是}
Shot 5 (11-14s): [Close-up, slow push in on her eyes, eye level, from the front of the desk] Ji Ran's gaze hardens into steely resolve, her lips pressed shut. Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, icy): {一个待价而沽的工具。}
At the end: Ji Ran stands behind the walnut executive desk, both hands planted on it, facing the pin-up wall with a hard gaze. The cup rests on its saucer at the pour-over station.

Image 10 is the first frame.

dialogue.speaker: ji_ran
dialogue.line: 五年前，纪宏远逼走路少泽，让我跟陈家联姻。现在路少泽发达了，又迫不及待悔婚，把我塞给路少泽。在他眼里，我永远都只是一个待价而沽的工具。
